messages:
cami: Quick weekly release train bulletin — please read. TL;DR: short embargo this Friday 02:00-06:00 UTC for infra patch; canary capacity will shift to eu-west for 2 hours at 03:00 UTC. If you have a release that needs exception, ping me by EOD today.

jordan: ack. can you confirm which services are in the embargo?

cami: core-serving, kv-cache, routing-proxy. Not affected: docs-portal, analytics-readonly.

devon: FYI - we have one in-progress dedicated deploy for the embeddings quant rollout. Should we gate that?

cami: yes — please pause that canary until after embargo. We'll re-open a second canary window Sat 08:00 UTC.

maya: noted. will pause and leave the pipeline in 'paused' state. @deploy-bot can you block auto-rollouts for project/embeddings until I toggle?

deploy-bot: @maya confirmed — auto-rollouts disabled for project/embeddings. Reason: release-train embargo (ticket #RT-214). :white_check_mark:

sanjay: quick question on capacity shift: is this purely routing-level or are we moving dedicated pools?

cami: routing-level shift + temporary pool rebalancing for eu-west to absorb canary load. Ops will spin up 3x p3-small equivalents for 2 hours.

rachael: ops-bot — can you attach the preflight checklist results?

ops-bot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECKLIST:
- infra health: ok
- db replicas lag: <250ms
- canary metric baselines: within expected ranges
- alerting hooks: verified
All green except one warning on model-cache warming (will clear on first run).

devon: leaving a note — if the quant kernel regression appears again, we'll auto-fallback to v2-kerneled models. Reminder: fallback requires a restart of routing-proxy pods (low-impact).

cami: good call. Adding fallback policy here for visibility:
```
policy: 
  name: canary-fallback-v2
  trigger: error-rate > 1% sustained 2m OR latency P95 > 2s
  action: reroute -> model:v2, notify -> #incidents, restart -> routing-proxy
```

jordan: Can someone post the exact command ops will run to scale the canary pool? I'll pin it to the ops runbook.

ops-bot: Use: `deployctl pool scale --env prod --pool eu-west-canary --count 3 --duration 2h`

maya: I'll also add a banner in the console UI tonight: "Planned brief embargo Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC — expect short canary shift" :loud_sound:

cami: thanks. Final ask: if you need an exception, post here with service name, owner, and reason. I'll triage tomorrow morning.

sanjay: exception request: embeddings-quant rollout (owner: devon) — high priority for partner demo Mon. If we must, we can target Sat 08:00 canary window.

cami: approved for Sat window. Devon, coordinate with Maya to resume pipeline and validate model smoke tests before enabling auto-rollout.

devon: will do. will run smoke suite and post results here when done.

rachael: i'll keep an eye on alerts during the window. tagging @oncall for visibility.

cami: thanks everyone. I'll post a short follow-up with the exact timeline and the embargo-notice snippet to ship in the Console. :shipit:

deploy-bot: NOTE: scheduled actions created — embargo-banner (2147488400), scale-eu-canary (2147486600).
